summary: Google DeepMind released version 1.0.5 of its open-source science-skills repository, adding a standardized credentials protocol and citation files, centralizing license notification storage, refactoring credential handling, migrating HTTP scripts to a new package, and removing the old scienceskillscommon skill.

practices.reason: Teams using these skills must update to the new credentials protocol, centralized license file location, and polite-http dependency since the old scienceskillscommon skill was removed.
practices.quote: Removed the local `scienceskillscommon` skill as its HTTP client functionality has been replaced by the `polite-http` package.
